verify-all.description: Runs full verification suite (tools/verify_gate.py --full) including static linters, scope & type checks, scene graph, property fuzzers, and index regenerations
verify-all.command: python3 tools/verify_gate.py --full || python tools/verify_gate.py --full || py -3 tools/verify_gate.py --full

lint-invariants.description: Executes domain AST invariant linter (tools/lint_invariants.py) to assert layer separation, zero allocations, and choke point contracts
lint-invariants.command: python3 tools/lint_invariants.py || python tools/lint_invariants.py || py -3 tools/lint_invariants.py

slice.description: Extracts targeted class methods, enums, signal declarations, or class headers without loading full files (tools/codebase_slice.py)
slice.command: python3 tools/codebase_slice.py || python tools/codebase_slice.py || py -3 tools/codebase_slice.py

search.description: Performs zero-dependency BM25 keyword search across markdown rules, specs, and GDScript docstrings (tools/semantic_search.py)
search.command: python3 tools/semantic_search.py || python tools/semantic_search.py || py -3 tools/semantic_search.py

benchmark.command: python3 tools/benchmark_math.py || python tools/benchmark_math.py || py -3 tools/benchmark_math.py

fuzz-formations.description: Executes 50,000 property-based stress tests asserting formation anchor safety and defensive line depths (tools/fuzz_formations.py)
fuzz-formations.command: python3 tools/fuzz_formations.py || python tools/fuzz_formations.py || py -3 tools/fuzz_formations.py

replay-test.description: Executes deterministic simulation replay verification asserting 0 bit-drift across fixed PRNG seeds (tools/replay_test.py)
replay-test.command: python3 tools/replay_test.py || python tools/replay_test.py || py -3 tools/replay_test.py

gen-symbols.description: Generates docs/SYMBOLS.json indexing every class, signal, enum, property, and method (tools/generate_symbols.py)
gen-symbols.command: python3 tools/generate_symbols.py || python tools/generate_symbols.py || py -3 tools/generate_symbols.py

eval-sim.description: Runs 60-second headless simulation assertion harness (tools/eval_simulation.py) asserting zero runtime invariant violations
eval-sim.command: python3 tools/eval_simulation.py --duration=60 || python tools/eval_simulation.py --duration=60 || py -3 tools/eval_simulation.py --duration=60

fuzz-solvers.description: Executes 100,000 property fuzzing iterations across kinematic solvers and boundary functions (tools/fuzz_solvers.py)
fuzz-solvers.command: python3 tools/fuzz_solvers.py || python tools/fuzz_solvers.py || py -3 tools/fuzz_solvers.py

formation-audit.description: Renders terminal ASCII formation spacing diagrams across tactical phases (tools/formation_ascii.py)
formation-audit.command: python3 tools/formation_ascii.py --all || python tools/formation_ascii.py --all || py -3 tools/formation_ascii.py --all

blast-radius.description: Calculates dependency DAG blast radius for a target file (tools/dump_dep_graph.py --blast-radius <target>)

dump-dep-graph.description: Scans all GDScript files and regenerates docs/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json static dependency DAG
dump-dep-graph.command: python3 tools/dump_dep_graph.py || python tools/dump_dep_graph.py || py -3 tools/dump_dep_graph.py

verify.description: Executes static GDScript checker (tools/gdcheck.py) and streams stdout/stderr
verify.command: python3 tools/gdcheck.py || python tools/gdcheck.py || py -3 tools/gdcheck.py

sync-rules.description: Parses structured logs in AGENTS_ERRATA.md and promotes pending rules into .claude/rules/ and docs/CORE_INVARIANTS.md
sync-rules.command: python3 tools/sync_rules.py || python tools/sync_rules.py || py -3 tools/sync_rules.py

compact-errata.description: Promotes pending rules, compacts session_state to last 3 entries, and archives history to docs/archive/errata_history.md
compact-errata.command: python3 tools/compact_errata.py || python tools/compact_errata.py || py -3 tools/compact_errata.py

rebuild-api.description: Regenerates docs/API_SURFACE.md across all 5 simulation layers from project GDScript sources
rebuild-api.command: python3 tools/dump_api.py || python tools/dump_api.py || py -3 tools/dump_api.py

next-task.description: Reads ROADMAP.md, finds the next unchecked item in 'PHASE 1 — Gameplay Completeness', and loads relevant file contexts
next-task.command: python3 tools/next_task.py || python tools/next_task.py || py -3 tools/next_task.py

layer-ctx.description: Extracts targeted layer context (rules, choke points, key files) for simulation layers 1-5
layer-ctx.command: python3 tools/layer_context.py || python tools/layer_context.py || py -3 tools/layer_context.py

session-bootstrap.description: Initializes session routing table, validates repository health via fast verification gate, and aligns on task context without token dumps
session-bootstrap.command: python3 tools/verify_gate.py --fast || python tools/verify_gate.py --fast || py -3 tools/verify_gate.py --fast

task-intake-routing.description: Classifies task requests, loads layer-scoped context, executes blast radius check, and prepares approval plan
task-intake-routing.command: python3 tools/verify_gate.py --fast || python tools/verify_gate.py --fast || py -3 tools/verify_gate.py --fast

feature-implementation.description: Executes feature request implementation workflow with roadmap alignment, layer context scoping, blast radius analysis, and verification gates
feature-implementation.command: python3 tools/verify_gate.py --fast || python tools/verify_gate.py --fast || py -3 tools/verify_gate.py --fast

bug-investigation.description: Systematic bug investigation workflow isolating root causes, enforcing layer invariants, checking blast radius, and running verification gates
bug-investigation.command: python3 tools/verify_gate.py --fast || python tools/verify_gate.py --fast || py -3 tools/verify_gate.py --fast
